mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.5% for two consecutive months, it signals severe labor market deterioration that triggers equity sell-offs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 9.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential construction permits (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, driving corporate earnings expectations upward and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery phases, a sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average signals improving manufacturing output, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods during post-recession recovery when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in housing starts (HOUST) over the past 3 months indicates strengthening residential demand, correlating with higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST rises for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5%, it indicates accelerating inflation that prompts Federal Reserve tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tightening labor market, signaling strong economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In zero-interest-rate environments (FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.25%), the Federal Reserve's commitment to low rates supports equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.25%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.
